## Before you ask for a review

- [ ] The tests pass (name the suites you ran).
- [ ] The standards check is clean.
- [ ] The docs are updated (README, INTEGRATION.md, a decision record if this decided something).
- [ ] No secret and no real data anywhere in the change: no tokens, passwords, API keys, real names, usernames, emails or grades.
- [ ] Words a person reads are in US English, use full product names ("Student Report Card", "Mentor Report Card") and plain hyphens, never long dashes.
- [ ] If this touches `contract/`, it has the `contract` label, and both product owners have approved.
